key_decisions: The blended Head Swap result is NOT carded and must not be - Fabio owns that workflow revisit and has tests still to run. MPI-572's sidecar read exonerated the app: Input_Tier was the NUMBER 2 and box1/box2 were {x,y,width,height}, both proven to land on a head by cropping them out of their own sources.

box1 and box2 needed DIFFERENT fixes, and the card's own wording was wrong about it. box1 masks (MpiBoxMask is full-frame, clips at the edge, and InpaintCropImproved's crop_magic_im grows the region back to the target aspect itself) so it needs NO pad. box2 crops straight into the text encoder with nothing to re-square it, so it needs `pad`. Padding the SOURCE is never right for a masked slot - it would grow the delivered picture.
`overflow` is bounded to HALF the box's own size, so its centre always stays over the content. Verified exact: a hard drag left reported x = -125 on a 250-wide box.
headSwapInjector's `_clampBox` was deleted (now `_intBox`). It mirrored a gizmo constraint that no longer exists, and a mirror of a deleted constraint silently rewrites a legal negative origin to 0.
